GainsBlock.rationale: `public override bool GainsBlock => true` (Impervious.cs:13) == the class attribute.

ctor.rationale: `base(2, CardType.Skill, CardRarity.Rare, TargetType.Self)` (Impervious.cs:19-22) == cost 2 / SKILL / RARE / SELF.

CanonicalVars.rationale: `new BlockVar(30m, ValueProp.Move)` (Impervious.cs:15) == `_block = 30`. Move without Unpowered -> POWERED block, so NOT in gap G1's blast radius -- which matters most here, since 30 is the largest block number in the pool and Vambrace doubles it on both sides.

OnPlay.rationale: `CreatureCmd.GainBlock(Owner.Creature, DynamicVars.Block, cardPlay)` (Impervious.cs:26) == `BlockCmd.apply(ctx.hooks, ctx.player, self._block, card=self)`. Single effect, no guards, no animation on either side.
